title: Stadsherberg, Batavia

buildingCutout.basis: Photo-derived former inn envelope registered to the nineteenth-century east quay site.

terrainReference.basis: Unmodified Copernicus GLO-30 at the reconstructed west entrance. The low masonry plinth meets the current elevation of the historic quay block.

mapIdentity.provider: 1881 Dutch cadastral survey aligned to surviving Sunda Kelapa landmarks

identities.name: Stadsherberg, Batavia
identities.address: Historic east quay at the Kleine Boom, Sunda Kelapa, Jakarta, Indonesia

mapIdentity.scope: The cadastral print and two surviving navigation landmarks fix the former east quay. The panorama locates the inn relative to the landing pavilion. The model uses a photo-derived footprint with approximate rear proportions.

note: Rijksmuseum period photographs show an eight-column waterfront veranda, balustraded cornice, a sign, tiled hipped roofs and a later shallow awning.
